text:
jordan: Heads-up: planning a v2 soft-launch for EU tenants tonight 2024-05-12 01:00-03:00 UTC. Target: non-critical "grace-tier" tenants first at 10% traffic, 30m pause, then 50% if telemetry looks good.
lexi: Noted. Is there a tenant whitelist or tag we use?
jordan: Yes — we'll use the 'grace-tier' tag. I'll DM the list to ops and SDK. Operators, are you ready to handle tenant-level evictions? :eyes:
ben: I'll be on pager. If median p95 latency > 250ms for 3 consecutive checks or error rate delta > 1.5x, we roll pin those tenants back to v1.
priya: Can we enable a gateway header fallback? Some older SDKs don't send the version header consistently.
ops-sre: Gateway header fallback is off by default. We can flip feature flag gw.v2_header_fallback=true per-region. Testing in staging now.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v2-eu-soft-launch -> 2024-05-12T01:00Z. Command: `/deploy start --region=eu --percent=10 --tag=grace-tier --window=02h`
jordan: Added a short note in release notes: SDKs must be >=1.3.2 for native v2 routing. Will ping @sdk-team to confirm messaging and auto-upgrade guidance. :memo:
sdk-team: we'll post a blurb in changelog and notify the Slack #sdk-updates channel. Gateway fallback buys us a safety net for older clients.
lexi: Also capturing KV cache warmup risk — some hosts may see a memory spike when many tenants hit cold KV caches. Ops, please monitor cache_evictions and host_memory_util.
ops-sre: Copy. We'll add cache_evictions > 0.02 and host_memory_util > 0.8 as autoscaler signals for the soft-launch window.
ben: If we see tenant-scoped 5xx/503s, prefer tenant-level pin: `/pin tenant <tenant_id> v1` rather than a global rollback. Sticky pin keeps unaffected tenants on v2.
jordan: Agreed. We'll keep global rollback as last resort. Also: rolling rollback plan available in runbook.
deploy-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/v2-soft-launch (ops checklist, rollback steps, pin commands)
lexi: Final ops plan: 01:00 start -> 10% for 30m, 01:30 evaluate telemetry + manual thumbs, 02:00 shift to 50% if green, 02:30 run expanded sweep toward 100% with 15m step increments. Ben and Priya on-call for the window. I'll update release tracker and changelog.
priya: I'll add a tiny eval harness — 50 prompt samples per tenant to check for latency regressions and hallucination increase. If we see regression score delta > 0.03 we trigger detailed investigation.
ben: I'll prepare tenant pin list quick command snippets and verify that the deploy-bot honors immediate pins during active rollout.
jordan: Thanks. One last note — please avoid editing client-facing docs during the window to keep noise down. Post any urgent notes to #customer-notify after we confirm impact. :thumbsup:
ops-sre: Staging tests passed for header fallback and autoscaler tweak. Ready to flip the flag during window if needed.
lexi: Great. I'll post an update 30m before start.
deploy-bot: Notification queued: 30m pre-launch. /remind ops 30m before 2024-05-12T01:00Z.
lexi: :eyes: everyone please ack when you see this thread.
